// AST-only fixture: close-ai cae8403cab57fbbe0ed5bf6a798ba3e37b654147
async function recordApplyBatchCheckpoints(
  queryable: ApplyBatchQueryable,
  input: RecordApplyBatchCheckpointsInput,
): Promise<RecordApplyBatchCheckpointsResult> {
  if (
    !isPositiveInteger(input.userId)
    || !isPositiveInteger(input.batchId)
    || typeof input.leaseToken !== 'string'
    || input.leaseToken.length < 1
    || Buffer.byteLength(input.leaseToken, 'utf8') > 1_024
    || !Number.isFinite(input.now.getTime())
    || !Array.isArray(input.checkpoints)
    || input.checkpoints.length < 1
    || input.checkpoints.length > MAX_CHECKPOINTS_PER_REQUEST
  ) {
    throw new ApplyBatchValidationError(
      `Apply checkpoint request must contain 1-${MAX_CHECKPOINTS_PER_REQUEST} bounded members.`,
    );
  }
  const idempotencyKeys = new Set<string>();
  const memberEpochs = new Set<string>();
  for (const checkpoint of input.checkpoints) {
    validateApplyBatchCheckpoint(checkpoint);
    idempotencyKeys.add(checkpoint.idempotencyKey);
    memberEpochs.add(`${checkpoint.memberId}:${checkpoint.inspectionEpoch}`);
  }
  if (
    idempotencyKeys.size !== input.checkpoints.length
    || memberEpochs.size !== input.checkpoints.length
  ) {
    throw new ApplyBatchValidationError(
      'Apply checkpoints require unique idempotency keys and member epochs.',
    );
  }

  // The HTTP mutation shares one transaction across all checkpoints. Probe
  // before any member writes; if a stale memo still permits a schema failure,
  // nothing commits -- the transaction rolls back. The per-checkpoint gate
  // remains as defence-in-depth.
  if (
    input.checkpoints.some((checkpoint) => checkpoint.actions.some(
      (action) => APPLY_BATCH_CHECKPOINT_ACTION_MAP[action.actionCode].actionType === 'upgrade_client',
    ))
    && !(await upgradeClientActionTypeSchemaReady(queryable))
  ) {
    throw new ApplyBatchSchemaPendingError(
      'client/upgrade_required checkpoints are not yet enabled on this server.',
    );
  }

  const results = await Promise.all(input.checkpoints.map(async (checkpoint) => {
    try {
      return await recordOneApplyBatchCheckpoint(queryable, {
        userId: input.userId,
        batchId: input.batchId,
        leaseToken: input.leaseToken,
        now: input.now,
      }, checkpoint);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ApplyBatchIdempotencyConflictError) {
        return {
          memberId: checkpoint.memberId,
          status: 'conflict' as const,
          errorCode: 'idempotency_payload_mismatch' as const,
        };
      }
      if (error instanceof ApplyBatchConflictError) {
        return {
          memberId: checkpoint.memberId,
          status: 'conflict' as const,
          errorCode: 'stale_member_state' as const,
        };
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }));
  await completeApplyBatchIfTerminal(queryable, {
    userId: input.userId,
    batchId: input.batchId,
    now: input.now,
  });
  return {
    results,
    questionPacket: buildApplyBatchQuestionPacket(results),
  };
}

// Schema-readiness dependency definitions from close-ai b1b2fbf7155f1eadd4a22bcef10525800dcad63f.
async function upgradeClientActionTypeSchemaReady(
  queryable: ApplyBatchQueryable,
): Promise<boolean> {
  return probeUpgradeClientActionTypeSchemaReady(queryable, 0);
}
async function probeUpgradeClientActionTypeSchemaReady(
  queryable: ApplyBatchQueryable,
  attempt: number,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (Date.now() < upgradeClientActionTypeReadyUntil) return true;
  const generation = migration511InvalidationGeneration;
  const constraintReady = await queryable.query(
    `SELECT (
       EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
           FROM pg_constraint
          WHERE conrelid = to_regclass('public.user_apply_human_actions')
            AND conname = 'user_apply_human_actions_action_type_check'
            AND convalidated
            AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%upgrade_client%'
       )
       AND NOT EXISTS (
         -- /admin/rollback-migration-511 phase 1 adds this NOT VALID guard
         -- before it drops/renames the wide constraint above. Postgres
         -- enforces a NOT VALID CHECK against new rows immediately, so once
         -- this guard exists an upgrade_client insert violates IT, not the
         -- still-validated wide constraint the query above inspects. Report
         -- not-ready for that whole window, not just once the wide
         -- constraint is finally dropped.
         SELECT 1
           FROM pg_constraint
          WHERE conrelid = to_regclass('public.user_apply_human_actions')
            AND conname = 'user_apply_human_actions_action_type_rollback_check'
       )
     ) AS ready`,
  );
  const ready = constraintReady.rows[0]?.ready === true;
  if (generation !== migration511InvalidationGeneration) {
    // An invalidation landed while this query was in flight -- this answer
    // is ambiguous relative to it (the DB read could have run either side
    // of the admin rollback's transaction), so discard it and re-probe
    // against the now-current generation instead of trusting or caching
    // it. Bounded so a pathological invalidation-every-probe scenario
    // fails safe (not ready) rather than recursing forever.
    return attempt >= 3 ? false : probeUpgradeClientActionTypeSchemaReady(queryable, attempt + 1);
  }
  upgradeClientActionTypeReadyUntil = ready ? Date.now() + MIGRATION_511_READY_TTL_MS : 0;
  return ready;
}

// Reviewed readiness cache state and invalidation from the same b1b2fbf commit.
const MIGRATION_511_READY_TTL_MS = 30_000;
let upgradeClientActionTypeReadyUntil = 0;
let migration511InvalidationGeneration = 0;
function invalidateMigration511Ready(): void {
  upgradeClientActionTypeReadyUntil = 0;
  migration511InvalidationGeneration += 1;
}
